import random

# Entry prompt for user to put in times for Swim, Bike, and running legs of race

print("\n \033[1mSwim Leg Data Entry\033[0m")
print("------------------------------------")

distance = float(input("Enter Swim Distance (in miles): "))
hours = float(input("Enter Swim Time (Hours): "))
minutes = float(input("Enter Swim Time (Minutes): "))
seconds = float(input("Enter Swim Time (Seconds): "))

print("\n\n \033[1mBike Leg Data Entry\033[0m")

hours2 = float(input("Enter Ride Time (Hours): "))
minutes2 = float(input("Enter Ride Time (Minutes): "))
seconds2 = float(input("Enter Ride Time (Seconds): "))

hours3 = float(input("Enter Run Time (Hours): "))

seconds3 = float(input("Enter Run Time (Seconds): "))

# Calculating and printing the random numbers for transistions 1 and 2

transition_minutes = random.randint(1, 5)
transition_seconds = random.randint(0, 60)
t1_total_sec = transition_minutes*60 + transition_seconds # converting to total seconds

transition_minutes2 = random.randint(1, 5)
transition_seconds2 = random.randint(0, 60)
t2_total_sec = transition_minutes2 * 60 + transition_seconds2 # converting to total seconds

print("\n\n\033[1mTransition Times\033[0m")
print("----------------------------------")

print(" Transition #1 Time:", transition_minutes , " Minute(s), ", transition_seconds , "Second(s)")

print(" Transition #2 Time:", transition_minutes2 , " Minute(s), ", transition_seconds2 , "Second(s)")

# Calculating  all results for the 3 categories of the race 
#Swim AVG pace per 100 yards 
swim_total_seconds = hours*3600 + minutes*60 + seconds #converting time to seconds
swim_total_yards = distance*1760 # converting miles to yards
swim_pace_per_yards = (swim_total_seconds / swim_total_yards) * 100 # Calculating pace

swim_pace_per_yards_min = int(swim_pace_per_yards // 60) # Minute
swim_pace_per_yards_sec = int(swim_pace_per_yards % 60) # Seconds

swim_pace_per_yards_minr = round(swim_pace_per_yards_min) #rounding
swim_pace_per_yards_secr = round(swim_pace_per_yards_sec)

# Bike Speed MPH Calculation
bike_total_seconds = hours2*3600 + minutes2*60 +seconds2 #converting time to seconds
total_bike_hours = bike_total_seconds / 3600 #converting to total Hours
bike_speed = distance2 / total_bike_hours # calculating bikes speed
bike_speedr = round(bike_speed, 2) # rounding

# Run Pace Per Mile Calculations
run_total_seconds = hours3*3600 + minutes3*60 +seconds3 #converting time to seconds
run_pace_per_mile = run_total_seconds / distance3 # calculating pace

run_pace_per_mile_min = int(run_pace_per_mile // 60) # Minutes
run_pace_per_mile_sec = int(run_pace_per_mile % 60) # Seconds

run_pace_per_mile_minr = round(run_pace_per_mile_min) #rounding
run_pace_per_mile_secr = round(run_pace_per_mile_sec)

# Printing all results for the 3 categories of the race

print("\n\n \033[1mTOTAL RACE RESULTS\033[0m")
print("-------------------------------------")
print("\n \033[1mSwim Results:\033[0m")
print("\tSwim Distance: " , distance , "Miles")
print("\tSwim Time: ", hours , "Hour(s)", minutes , "Minute(s)", seconds , "Second(s)")
print("\tSwim Pace: " , swim_pace_per_yards_minr , "Minute(s)", swim_pace_per_yards_secr , "Second(s) Per 100 Yards")

print("\n \033[1mBike Results:\033[0m")

print("\tBike Time: ", hours2 , "Hour(s)", minutes2 , "Minute(s)", seconds2 , "Second(s)")

print("\n \033[1mRun Results:\033[0m")

Energy Usage Calculator

Python coding | Computer Science, Spring 2026

kozak_energyemissions.py Download .py file 
# Michael Kozak

def calcEnergy(numOfBulbs, hoursPerDay, watts):
    energy = (watts * hoursPerDay * numOfBulbs * 30) / 1000
    return energy 

def calccO2(energy):
    cO2 = energy * 0.41
    return cO2

def compareUseage(ledcO2, inccO2):
    if ledcO2 == inccO2:
        print("Both Lighting Types Produce The Same Amount Of Energy and Emisions")
    else:
        if ledcO2 < inccO2:
            difference = ((inccO2 - ledcO2)/inccO2) * 100
            differenceR = round(difference, 2)
            print("LED Bulbs Are More Efficient by: %", differenceR)
        else:
            difference = ((ledcO2 - inccO2)/ledcO2) * 100
            differenceR = round(difference, 2)
            print("Incandescent Bulbs Are More Efficient by: %", differenceR)

def main():
    print("LED and Incadescent Bulb Comparison")
    print("-----------------------------------")

    numOfBulbs = int(input("\nEnter The Amount of Bulbs Used: "))
    hoursPerDay = float(input("Enter The Average Number of Hours The Light Is Used Per Day: "))
    wattsLED = float(input("Enter The Wattage of One LED Bulb:"))
    wattsINC = float(input("Enter The Wattage of One Incandescent Bulb:"))

    ledEnergy = calcEnergy(numOfBulbs, hoursPerDay, wattsLED)
    incEnergy = calcEnergy(numOfBulbs, hoursPerDay, wattsINC)

    ledcO2 = calccO2(ledEnergy)
    inccO2 = calccO2(incEnergy)

    ledEnergyR = round(ledEnergy, 2)
    incEnergyR = round(incEnergy, 2)

    ledcO2R = round(ledcO2, 2)
    inccO2R = round(inccO2, 2)

    print("\n\n Your Monthly Results")
    print("-------------------------")
    print("\nLED Energy Useage" , ledEnergyR , "kWh")
    print("LED CO2 Emission", ledcO2R, "kg")

    print("\nIncandescent Energy Useage", incEnergyR, "kWh")
    print("Incandescent CO2 Emission", inccO2R, "kg")

    print("\n")
    compareUseage(ledcO2R, inccO2R)

main()
